stem: You need to stop your office's own visits appearing in GA4 reports. What should you configure?

options.text: Define internal traffic by IP in the web stream tag settings, then activate the Internal traffic data filter
Create an audience of office visitors, then share it with Google Ads as an exclusion list
Create a segment that excludes office sessions in a free-form exploration, then share that exploration with the team
Add the office IP range to the list of unwanted referrals in the web stream tag settings
